description: Rewrites a Bash command to its filtered `rtk` form before it runs, through RTK's own hook processor (`rtk hook claude`). Fails open: no `rtk` on PATH, an `rtk` that errors or lacks `hook claude`, or a command with no RTK equivalent leaves the command untouched and never blocks it. Runs the deterministic skill script directly, with no model call, when `/pc-rtk:gain` is typed bare or with plain read flags (UserPromptExpansion); any other arguments fall back to the skill.

hooks.command: command -v rtk >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; rtk hook claude || exit 0
